  • Method Details

    • loadPlayerData

      public void loadPlayerData() throws IOException
      Loads player data from a file and updates the player accordingly.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading the file.

    • movePlayer

      public void movePlayer(char c)
      Sets player movement speed and facing attribute in the specified direction based on pressed key. When moving, player is always moving at max speed.
      Parameters:
      c - The direction character ('w' for up, 'a' for left, 's' for down, 'd' for right).

    • stopPlayer

      public void stopPlayer()
      Stops player movement.

    • update

      public void update()
      Advances state of the game, key method of model and whole game. If the player is dead, triggers the "gameOver" method in the controller. Otherwise, updates the player, enemies, projectiles, and checks for hits and item pickups.

    • updatePlayer

      public void updatePlayer()
      Advances the state of player. Updates the player's position and actions. Prevents the movement in case of hitting block that cannot be walked on or the edge of the board.

    • openChest

      public void openChest(Chest chest)
      Opens a chest, triggering the necessary actions and updates, like replacing the block, removing key from player's inventory or dropping coins.
      Parameters:
      chest - The chest to be opened.

    • updateEnemies

      public void updateEnemies()
      Updates the positions and actions of enemies. Prevents the movement in case of hitting block that cannot be walked on or the edge of the board.

    • directionToPlayer

      public String directionToPlayer(Enemy enemy)
      Calculates the direction in which should the enemy shoot. The projectile in this direction will be the closest to the player.
      Parameters:
      enemy - enemy, whose position is used in the calculation
      Returns:
      The direction from the enemy to the player ("up", "down", "left", or "right").

    • updateProjectiles

      public void updateProjectiles()
      Updates the positions of projectiles. Delete those that are out of bounds or collide with obstacles.

    • checkHits

      public void checkHits()
      Checks for collisions between player's projectiles and enemies, and between projectiles of enemies and the player. Deletes projectiles that hit. Updates enemy and player health accordingly.

    • checkItemPickUp

      public void checkItemPickUp()
      Checks if the player is picking up any items on the board. If the player picks up an item, it is added to their inventory and further actions are taken based on the item type.

    • checkUpgrade

      public void checkUpgrade()
      Checks if the player's inventory contains any coins with a value of 100 or more. If such coins are found, the player is eligible for an upgrade and the upgrade process is triggered. Player is given choice

    • killEnemy

      public void killEnemy(Enemy enemy)
      Kills the specified enemy and determines the item to drop based on its drop type. The item is added to the list of items in the game.
      Parameters:
      enemy - The enemy to be killed.

    • allEnemiesDead

      public boolean allEnemiesDead()
      Check if all enemies are dead, so the level can be endedx.
      Returns:
      true if all enemies are dead or the list is empty, false otherwise.
